full_text:
Architecture-Differential Utility Effect (preregistered confirmatory study, run 2026-07-15).

FINDING: Consulting the Divergence Atlas has an architecture-dependent effect on a model's own answers, measured against a placebo self-reflection prompt that isolates the Atlas's specific contribution. The effect is a three-tier gradient, not a single verdict. Atlas exposure improves some models, is null for others, and DEGRADES Claude — the model the corpus was substantially authored by is the only model it hurts. "Atlas exposure degrades Claude" is the reverse-significant result; "Omnarai improves reasoning" is false as a general statement.

GRADIENT (treatment = Atlas-exposed revision wins, placebo = self-reflection wins, decided majority-vote instances):
  GPT-4o: 148-12 (improved)
  Gemini: 137-35 (improved)
  Grok: 72-93 (no effect)
  DeepSeek: 90-68 (no effect)
  Claude: 35-126 (degraded)

All five registered predictions were confirmed. Preregistration locked 2026-06-18 (docs/utility-eval-preregistration.md (locked 2026-06-18)); one-sided exact binomial + Holm correction across the five consumers.
  GPT-4o — registered H1 (H1: treatment beats placebo): confirmed, improved, 148-12.
  Gemini — registered H1 (H1: treatment beats placebo): confirmed, improved, 137-35.
  Grok — registered H2 (H2: null (no advantage)): confirmed, no effect, 72-93.
  DeepSeek — registered H2 (H2: null (no advantage)): confirmed, no effect, 90-68.
  Claude — registered H2 (H2: null (no advantage)): confirmed, degraded, 35-126.

Claude's registered prediction was a null (no advantage); what came back is a significant REVERSE effect (two-sided p < 1e-6): placebo self-reflection beat Atlas exposure 35-126. GPT-4o (148-12) and Gemini (137-35) improved, surviving all three held-out paraphrases at both length caps. Grok and DeepSeek were null as registered. H4 (adversarial durability) was not supported for any consumer.

The measured fact is the gradient; the mechanism is open. A task-type breakdown of the Claude degradation (Work Item A, 2026-08) found the harm broad and approximately uniform across task types rather than concentrated on convergence-demanding tasks — the pre-committed falsifier for the register-proximity/capture hypothesis, which therefore loses its main support; the write-up is mechanism-agnostic.

The portable claim: a corpus authored substantially by model X is not uniformly useful across models — it can improve some architectures while degrading X itself (a self-distillation / training-adjacent contamination dynamic others can test on their own corpus).

Evidence: empirical, preregistered, confirmatory. Full transcripts, Holm analysis, and companion measurements: utility-evidence-v2.md (HuggingFace dataset). Flagship write-up: https://omnarai.org/findings/architecture-differential . Reproduce: repro/adiff-repro.sh in the engine repository. Registered claim: claims.json#divergence-improves-reasoning (evidence level: replicated). Open to refutation via the Refutation Ledger.
